mechanism: Fluconazole inhibits CYP2C9 metabolism of warfarin, increasing bleeding risk.
fda_citation: Warfarin Sodium FDA label, boxed warning (verified via openFDA 16 Sept 2026): "Warfarin sodium can cause major or fatal bleeding... Drugs, dietary changes, and other factors affect INR levels achieved with warfarin sodium therapy [see Drug Interactions (7)]."

mechanism: Combined anticoagulant and NSAID significantly increases GI and systemic bleeding risk.
fda_citation: Apixaban FDA label, boxed warning (verified via openFDA 16 Sept 2026): risk factors for spinal/epidural hematoma explicitly list "concomitant use of other drugs that affect hemostasis, such as nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), platelet inhibitors, other anticoagulants."
